THE CHINA PRESS, FRIDAY, JUNE 25, 1937
Yannoulatos, Greek Consul,
Leaving Tomorrow For Europe
Wellknown Shanghai
Resident To Be Gone
Six Months
Mr. Emm. P. Yannoulatos,
Managing Partner of Yannoulatos
Bros. (China) and Acting Consul-
General for Greece, is leaving to-
morrow at 11 o'clock in the morn-
ing on the s.s. Tsingtao Maru for
Europe and America.
Mr. Yannoulatos, who is travel-
ling by way of Dairen and Siberia
to Europe, expects to be present
at the drilling operations of his
firm's oil concession in Macedonia,
where oil has recently been dis-
covered. He will first report to his
government in Athens.
Mr. Yannoulatos will be accom-
panied by Mrs. Yannoulatos and
expects to be away for about six
months, returning to Shanghai by
way of America.
During his absence; his younger
brother, Mr. Paul Yannoulatos, will
be in charge of the Consulate-
General for Greece and of his
brother's business connections.
Mr. Yannoulatos first came to
China 30 years ago and establish-
ed himself in Chefoo as a silk ex-
porter. In 1925 he was honored by
the Peking Government with a
special letter of commendation for
services rendered to China.
He has established two firms, the
China Merchants Fongee Associa-
tion, which deals exclusively in
the export of silk and Chinese
produce to foreign countries, and
Yannoulatos Bros., which is mainly
interested in shipping. He is also
a director of the recently incor-
Leaving
Emm. P. Yannoulatos
porated Anglo-Hellenic Steamship
Company, Ltd., of Shanghai.
Mr. Yannoulatos has always been
an ardent friend of China and has
done much, especially since his
appointment as Acting Consul-
General for Greece, to cement the
excellent relations between the two
countries.
He has been honored by several
farewell parties, official and private,
during the past several days.

《大美晚报》，1937年6月25日，星期五
希腊领事 Yannoulatos
明日启程赴欧
上海知名居民
将离开六个月
Yannoulatos 兄弟公司（中国）管理合伙人、希腊代理总领事 Emm. P. Yannoulatos 先生，将于明日上午11时乘坐“青岛丸”号轮船（s.s. Tsingtao Maru）前往欧美。
Yannoulatos 先生将经大连和西伯利亚前往欧洲，他预计届时将出席其公司在马其顿石油特许权区域的钻探作业，该地最近发现了石油。他将首先向雅典的希腊政府汇报。
Yannoulatos 夫人将陪同 Yannoulatos 先生同行，预计离家约六个月，之后将经由美国返回上海。
在他离任期间，其弟 Paul Yannoulatos 先生将负责希腊总领事馆事务及其兄长的商业联系。
Yannoulatos 先生于30年前首次来到中国，并在烟台从事丝绸出口业务。1925年，因对中国提供服务，北京政府授予他特别嘉奖令以示荣誉。
他创办了两家公司：华商绸缎协会（China Merchants Fongee Association），专门从事丝绸和中国土产对国外的出口业务；以及 Yannoulatos 兄弟公司，主要经营航运业。他还是最近在上海注册的英希轮船有限公司（Anglo-Hellenic Steamship Company, Ltd.）的董事。
离开
Emm. P. Yannoulatos
Yannoulatos 先生一直是中国的热忱朋友，尤其是自被任命为希腊代理总领事以来，他为巩固两国之间的良好关系做了大量工作。
在过去几天里，官方和私人举办了几场欢送会向他致敬。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS. THURSDAY, JULY 30, 1936

THE first issue of the "Grecian
Bulletin for the Far East" has been
published as a half-yearly journal to
promote economic relations between
Greece and the Far East. Appro-
priately it starts with an article by
Mr. Emm. P. Yannoulatos; the Acting
Consul-General for Greece on the
"Early and present commercial rela-
tions and trade possibilities for China
and Greece." The bulletin is attrac-
tively illustrated and does credit to
its editor and manager Mr. N. G.
Tretchikoff.

《字林西报》，1936年7月30日，星期四

《远东希腊公报》首期已作为半年刊出版，旨在促进希腊与远东之间的经济关系。恰如其分的是，开篇即为希腊代理总领事 Emm. P. Yannoulatos 先生撰写的文章，题为“中国与希腊的早期及当前商业关系和贸易前景”。该公报插图精美，为其编辑兼经理 N. G. Tretchikoff 先生增光不少。

CONSULATE GENERAL FOR
GREECE

NOTICE

NOTICE is hereby given of the
establishment of the Consulate Gen-
eral for Greece, at 120 Jinkee Road.
Telephone 10312.
All Greek Citizens are required to
apply for registration and receive the
necessary Certificates of Nationality
as called for by the Consular Code.
Those failing to do so will be sub-
ject to the penalties provided for by
the said Consular Code.
EMMANUEL P. YANNOULATOS,
Vice-Consul in Charge
Shanghai, September 10, 1934.

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, FRIDAY, AUGUST 7, 1936.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
No. D 6391
Date / /

GREEK CONSULATE
IN SHANGHAI

Country Represented Here
for the First Time

With the appointment of Mr. Emmanuel P. Yannoulatos, prominent Greek merchant of Shanghai as Honorary Consul for Greece and the opening up of the Offices of the Greek Consulate General at 120 Jinkee Road, Greece will be for the first time represented in this city.

One of the most prominent silk merchants and exporters in North China and the active executive head of three important firms Mr. Yannoulatos has been in the Orient for almost thirty years having come to China in 1906 to represent his father's firm and other Greek manufacturers and producers. Born on August 19, 1887 he received his education at the Commercial College of Greece and served his apprenticeship at one of the agencies of the Credit Lyonnais in Greece.

In 1910 in Chefoo he organized the China Merchants Pongee Association, of which he is still the general manager with head offices in Shanghai and a branch at Chefoo, and later established with his brothers the firm of Yannoulatos Brothers (China) of Chefoo and Shanghai, exporters, shipping and insurance agents. In 1932 in partnership with Mr. Paul Le Bris, former President of the French Municipal Council, he formed the P. Le Bris Export-Import S.R.L. of Shanghai and Paris of which he is the managing director in China. Mr. Yannoulatos is the Far Eastern representative of the principal shipping interests of his country. The firm

[图片：Mr. Emmanuel P. Yannoulatos]

of Messrs. Yannoulatos Brothers were also recently granted a concession by the Greek Government for the exploitation of the oil deposits in Macedonia, where the final survey is now being made by prominent German scientists.

Mr. Yannoulatos also has the distinction of receiving in 1915 the commendation of the Chinese Government for the valuable services rendered by his firm to this country.

He has served as president of the Greek community (1927-1932) also of the Hellenic Benevolent Society of China and has always taken a keen interest in the welfare of the Greek Community. During the past 25 years he has frequently written enlightening articles concerning Greece for the Foreign Press of this country.

In a statement yesterday Mr. Yannoulatos said: "My appointment is an honorary one and I will continue to serve until such time as my Government decides to send to Shanghai a Consul-General from Home. In meantime I shall strive to serve the interests of our communities under my jurisdiction and to cultivate closer commercial intercourse between my country and China. Two of the oldest countries of the world, China and Greece, commercially, know very little of each other; I am, therefore, happy of the opportunities this appointment will afford me to work and serve the interests of both."

Mr. and Mrs. Yannoulatos left yesterday morning for a short vacation in Tsingtao and Chefoo.

《字林西报》，1936年8月7日，星期五。
上海公共租界工部局警务处
编号 D 6391
日期 / /

驻上海希腊领事馆

该国首次在此设立代表机构

随着上海知名希腊商人 Emmanuel P. Yannoulatos 先生被任命为希腊名誉领事，以及希腊总领事馆办公室在静安寺路120号的开设，希腊将首次在本市设立代表机构。

Yannoulatos 先生是华北最著名的丝绸商人和出口商之一，也是三家重要公司的活跃执行负责人。他在东方已近三十年，于1906年来华，代表其父亲的公司及其他希腊制造商和生产者。他出生于1887年8月19日，在希腊商业学院接受教育，并在希腊里昂信贷银行（Credit Lyonnais）的一家代理机构当过学徒。

1910年，他在烟台组建了华商绸缎协会（China Merchants Pongee Association），他至今仍担任总经理，总部设在上海，并在烟台设有分部。后来，他与兄弟们共同建立了位于烟台和上海的 Yannoulatos 兄弟公司（中国），从事出口、航运和保险代理业务。1932年，他与前法国公董局主席 Paul Le Bris 先生合伙，成立了上海和巴黎的 P. Le Bris 进出口有限责任公司（P. Le Bris Export-Import S.R.L.），他担任该公司在华总经理。Yannoulatos 先生是其祖国主要航运利益集团在远东的代表。该公司

[图片：Mr. Emmanuel P. Yannoulatos]

Yannoulatos 兄弟公司最近还获得了希腊政府授予的马其顿石油矿藏开采特许权，目前德国著名科学家正在那里进行最终勘测。

Yannoulatos 先生还享有殊荣，曾于1915年因其公司对本国提供的宝贵服务而获得中国政府的嘉奖。

他曾担任希腊侨民社区主席（1927-1932），也曾担任中华希腊慈善会主席，并始终密切关注希腊侨民社区的福祉。在过去25年里，他经常为本国的外文报刊撰写关于希腊的发人深省的文章。

Yannoulatos 先生在昨日的一份声明中说：“我的任命是名誉性质的，我将继续任职，直到我国政府决定从国内派遣一位总领事来上海为止。在此期间，我将努力为我管辖下的社区利益服务，并促进我国与中国之间更紧密的商业往来。中国和希腊是世界上最古老的两个国家，但在商业上彼此了解甚少；因此，我很高兴这一任命为我提供了工作和服务于双方利益的机会。”

Yannoulatos 夫妇已于昨晨前往青岛和烟台短期度假。

* 另见 D. 5500。

I.O. 8983.

存于机密科
